description: A Windows tray app that protects each output device from sudden volume jumps.
notes: Requires Windows 11 and Microsoft Edge WebView2. Launching enables volume protection. Login startup is managed separately.
Verify the installed earmuff.exe file without launching it.
Companion skill: npx skills add Hezric/Earmuff -g (optional; use your own skill manager if you have one).
Scoop keeps the running executable at a fixed physical path under persist to retain tray placement across updates. Stop the app before updating. The first migration may require placing the icon once.
